grounded_conductor_FV.branch: Classical electron-repelling, unresolved grounded conductor: phi_wall=0, phi_s>=-1e-10V
grounded_conductor_FV.potential_drop: DeltaPhi=phi_plasma_side - phi_wall=phi_s, negative beyond tolerance rejected
grounded_conductor_FV.electron_energy: (Gamma_e/N_A)*(2*T_e+DeltaPhi) eV mol/(m^2 s) in molar-state mode
grounded_conductor_FV.boundary_potential: Prescribed grounded conducting wall, not a dynamic dielectric surface-charge interface
grounded_conductor_FV.SEE: Separate ion-induced SEE source; no electron-induced/floating/inverse-sheath claim

C2_newonly.electron_drop: DeltaPhi_adj=smoothPositive(E_n*d_perp), E=-grad(phi) using plasma-side FaceArg/adjacent element; not guaranteed phi_s-0
C2_newonly.electron_particle: Gamma_e=s*n_e*vbar/4*exp(-DeltaPhi_adj/T_e); negative E_n*d_perp is smoothly clamped rather than rejected as out-of-branch
C2_newonly.electron_energy: (Gamma_e/N_A)*(5/2*T_e) eV mol/(m^2 s), no explicit DeltaPhi energy addend
C2_newonly.general_FV_BC: FVFunctorNeumannBC with -1/N_A factor, five grouped inlet/outlet/electrode/metal/right sidesets per ion; FV library sign must be checked at residual level
C2_newonly.walls: three dielectric groups plasma_cover/plasma_wafer/plasma_focus_ring, three species each; 3 general BC+9 dielectric=12 ion BC objects total
C2_newonly.surface_current: j=e*(Gamma_O2p+Gamma_Op-Gamma_Om-Gamma_e) on each dielectric, used to drive lower-D sigma_s and surface charge Poisson BC
C2_newonly.SEE: Not auto-generated in C2 net surface current expression; dielectric material-specific SEE requires independent declared owner/provenance and separate acceptance.
C2_newonly.electrostatic: dielectric sigma_s / interface Poisson coupling is not same as conductor phi_wall=0 Dirichlet boundary

analytic_non_equivalence.zero_drop: At identical n_e, T_e and sticking=1: grounded Gamma_e=C2 Gamma_e when both drops vanish, BUT grounded energy per collected electron=2 T_e, C2 energy per collected electron=2.5 T_e, 25% higher C2.
analytic_non_equivalence.general: Even electron particle Gamma can differ because phi_s-phi_wall need not equal E_n*d_perp; nonuniform potential/FE gradient, dielectric charging, mesh change matter.
analytic_non_equivalence.negative_drop: Grounded collector rejects phi_s<-1e-10V; C2 electron material clamps negative adjacent field drop. Not identical validity branches.
analytic_non_equivalence.rate_source_and_ownership: Source-only S6 C2 Wall and legacy IonWall objects are a different migration from historical FEM grounded sheath; correct SHA/name remap cannot prove scientific equivalence.
